title: The Whispering Brook
story:
James waded deeper into the sea of goldenflowers, the sweet, powdery scent of pollen tickling his nose. The warm afternoon sun felt wonderful on his back, so different from the cool, damp shadows of his old canopy home. Every step forward revealed a new wonder, from tiny orange butterflies that fluttered up like living confetti to the soft, rhythmic hum of busy bumblebees.

Just as he was beginning to wonder where this vast yellow ocean ended, a new sound caught his attention. It was a gentle, liquid giggling—a soft, repetitive splashing that promised cool relief. Curious, James pushed through a dense patch of wild clover and stepped onto a bank of smooth, sun-baked river stones.

Before him stretched a narrow, crystal-clear brook, its waters sparkling like scattered diamonds under the bright sky. Tiny blue dragonflies with wings like stained glass hovered over the surface, playing a quiet game of tag. James sat on a warm, flat rock at the water's edge and dipped a single toe into the stream, giggling at the sudden, refreshing chill. As he watched a wide oak leaf drift by like a tiny green boat carrying a ladybug, he realized the world was full of small wonders.
